<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".18"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000" opacity=".035"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="21" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="15" x2="330" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="13" x2="335" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="11" x2="340" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="305" cy="16" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="294" y1="20" x2="301" y2="13" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="301" y1="13" x2="308" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <rect x="353" y="10" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="377" y="14" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="355" y="12" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Back control -->
  <g opacity=".95">
    <polyline points="31,71 22,80 31,89" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="80" x2="43" y2="80" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tinder branding -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="194,89 185,104 185,114 191,121 200,122 208,116 209,106 203,99 201,108 196,103" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="157" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="34" font-weight="500" letter-spacing="-1.2" fill="#FFFFFF">tinder</text>
    <text x="195" y="181" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".92">Meet interesting people nearby.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Social sign-in buttons -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="56" y="226" width="278" height="48" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="87" cy="250" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="92" cy="239" rx="4" ry="2.2" transform="rotate(-28 92 239)" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="255" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" letter-spacing=".1" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH APPLE</text>
  </g>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="56" y="288" width="278" height="48" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="87" cy="312" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="87" y="318" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">f</text>
    <text x="195" y="317" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" letter-spacing=".1" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH FACEBOOK</text>
  </g>

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="56" y="350" width="278" height="48" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="78" y="362" width="17" height="25" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="86.5" cy="382.5" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="201" y="379" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="500" letter-spacing=".1" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN WITH PHONE NUMBER</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <g opacity=".75">
    <line x1="57" y1="436" x2="157" y2="436" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="233" y1="436" x2="333" y2="436" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="195" y="440" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">OR</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Account action -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="90" y="462" width="210" height="44" rx="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="195" y="489" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".2" fill="#FE3675">CREATE ACCOUNT</text>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="543" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Already have an account?</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="90" y="558" width="210" height="44" rx="62" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="195" y="585" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" letter-spacing=".2" fill="#FFFFFF">SIGN IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Legal copy -->
  <text x="195" y="638" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10.5" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">By signing in, you agree to our</text>
  <text x="195" y="655" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10.5" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Terms of Service <tspan font-weight="400">and</tspan> Privacy Policy.</text>
  <line x1="132" y1="658" x2="194" y2="658" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width=".7"/>
  <line x1="206" y1="658" x2="267" y2="658" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width=".7"/>

  <!-- Trouble link -->
  <text x="195" y="700" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Trouble signing in?</text>
  <line x1="143" y1="703" x2="247" y2="703" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width=".8"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="758" width="390" height="86" fill="#000000" opacity=".13"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="758" x2="390" y2="758" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity=".22"/>

  <!-- Explore -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,779 48,773 57,779 54,792 42,792" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="782" r="2.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="48" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Likes -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="117,775 120,782 128,783 122,788 124,796 117,792 110,796 112,788 106,783 114,782" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="117" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Likes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Matches -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="782" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="190" cy="779" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="200" cy="779" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <text x="195" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Matches</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="267" y="774" width="19" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <polygon points="271,789 271,794 277,789" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    <circle cx="272" cy="781" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="277" cy="781" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="282" cy="781" r="1.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="277" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Messages</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="345" cy="778" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="345" cy="790" rx="9" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="345" y="814" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="166" y="830" width="58" height="4" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity=".9"/>
</svg>
